description: Contract calendar. One row per active contract, tracking the window between 'this expires' and 'someone is working it'. NOT a second pipeline — once a renewal opportunity exists, this row points at it and the opportunity carries the commercial detail.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.note: Links to customers.csv

columns.name: contract_end_date
columns.note: When the current contract expires

columns.name: auto_renew
columns.note: Whether the contract renews without action. INVERTS the risk, so read it rather than assuming: 'no' means doing nothing loses the contract; 'yes' means doing nothing renews it. The profile records the org's default where contracts are consistent.

columns.name: notice_period_days
columns.note: Days before expiry that formal notice must be given. Many orgs have no formal notice period — the profile says. Blank means unknown or not applicable, never zero.

columns.name: notice_deadline
columns.note: DERIVED where a notice period exists: contract_end_date minus notice_period_days. Where there is no formal notice period, conversation_target_date is the operative deadline instead.

columns.name: days_to_notice
columns.note: DERIVED. Negative means the window has closed.

columns.name: days_to_expiry
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: current_value
columns.note: Value of the contract now up for renewal

columns.name: renewal_opp_id
columns.note: Local OPP id once a renewal opportunity exists. Blank = nobody is working this yet, which is the whole reason this registry exists.

columns.name: renewal_opp_stage
columns.note: Denormalised from the opportunity so the spreadsheet reads without lookups

columns.name: renewal_opp_created_date
columns.note: When the renewal opportunity was created. Where the org creates one at deal close, a long gap between contract start and this date is itself the finding.

columns.name: first_renewal_touch_date
columns.note: First email or meeting with the customer explicitly about this renewal. Detectable from sent mail — this is what proves the conversation actually started rather than being merely planned.

columns.name: conversation_target_date
columns.note: DERIVED: contract_end_date minus the org's renewal_conversation_lead_days (profile). The date by which the customer should have heard from you.

columns.name: days_to_conversation_target
columns.note: DERIVED. Negative and first_renewal_touch_date blank means the commitment has already been missed.

columns.name: original_opp_id
columns.note: The deal that created the current contract

columns.name: proposed_value
columns.note: From the renewal opportunity, once one exists

columns.name: outcome
columns.note: Set on close. Compare proposed_value to current_value.

columns.name: closed_since_last_forecast
columns.note: DERIVED: resolved since the previous forecast of this cadence. Drives the 'what moved' callout.

columns.name: risk_flags
columns.note: DERIVED, semicolon-separated: no-renewal-opp;conversation-overdue;conversation-due-soon;notice-window-closing;champion-left;no-qbr;quiet;contraction-risk

columns.name: expansion_signal
columns.note: Evidence this could grow — new teams, usage at cap, adjacent need
